1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada
1 Disember 2011.

Golongan lesen

2. Golongan dan per ihalan lesen berkenaan dengan perniagaan perkhidmatan
wang adalah dinyatakan dalam Jadual Pertama.

Pengemukaan maklumat bagi permohonan lesen

3. Seseorang pemohon yang memohon suatu lesen di bawah subseksyen 5(1) Akta
hendaklah mengemukakan kepada Bank maklumat yang berikut:

(a) butiran mengenai pemegang syer pemohon itu—

(i) jika pemegang syer pemohon itu ialah suatu syarikat, nama,
alamat dan butir -butir bagi menghubungi pemegang
syernya, jumlah dan peratus syer yang dipegang dengan
pemohon itu; atau

(ii) jika pemegang syer pemohon itu ialah selain suatu syarikat,
nama, alamat dan butir -butir bagi menghubungi orang

tersebut, jumlah dan peratus syer yang dipegang dengan
pemohon itu;

(b) nama, alamat dan butir-butir bagi menghubungi lembaga pengarah
dan pengurusan atasan pemohon itu, peranan dan tanggungjawab
mereka dalam perniagaan perkhidmatan wang yang dicadangkan
itu;

(c) struktur korporat pemohon yang dicadangkan, hubungannya
dengan mana -mana syarikat berkaitan dan syarikat pegangan
dalam kumpulan itu, nama syarikat itu, peratus pemegangan
saham dan suatu penjelasan ringkas mengenai aktiviti setiap satu
syarikat tersebut;

(d) perancangan perniagaan yang dicadangkan bagi perniagaan
perkhidmatan wang itu—

(i) analisis daya maju yang meliputi model perniagaan, asas
potensi pelanggan, saluran pengedaran dan unjuran
prospek pembangunan bagi tiga tahun ke hadapan;

(ii) unjuran pendapatan dan aliran tunai bagi tiga tahun ke
hadapan; dan

(iii) sumber dana pemohon bagi memenuhi dana modal
minimum dan bagi membiayai operasi perniaga an
perkhidmatan wangnya;

(e) perkiraan tadbir urus, kawalan dalaman dan kerangka pengurusan
risiko yang dicadangkan untuk mengurus operasi perniagaan
perkhidmatan wang yang dicadangkan untuk memastikan—

(i) pengendalian yang baik bagi perniagaan perkhidmatan
wang dan integriti bagi operasinya;

(ii) pematuhan terhadap kehendak Akta ini dan peraturan -
peraturannya, garis panduannya, pekelilingnya,
piawaiannya atau notisnya;

(iii) penyelesaian bagi kemungkinan salah pengurusan dan
fraud; dan

(iv) perlindungan yang mencukupi atas pelanggan; dan

(f) cadangan mekanisma kawalan dalam dan progam pematuhan bagi
mematuhi Akta Pencegahan Pengubahan Wang Haram dan
Pencegahan Pembiayaan Keganasan 2001 [ Akta 613 ] dan garis
panduannya yang berhubungan dengan—

(i) cadangan orang yang akan diberi kuasa dan tanggungjawab
lembaga pengarah dan pengurusannya dalam
melaksanakan langkah pencegahan pengubahan wang
haram dan pembiayaan keganasan; dan

(ii) cadangan program pematuhan pencegahan pengubahan
wang haram dan pembiayaan keganasan yang berhubungan
dengan dasar dan tatacara yang dicadangkan bagi
penerimaan pelanggan, usaha wajar terhadap pelanggan,
pemantauan berterusan, penyimpanan rekod, laporan ke
atas transaksi yang disyaki dan menangani pembiayaian
keganasan.

Tempoh lesen

4. Sesuatu lesen hendaklah berkuat kuasa bagi suatu tempoh selama tiga tahun
melainkan suatu tempoh singkat ditentukan oleh Bank sebaliknya dalam lesen itu.

Fi

5. Seseorang pemegang lesen hendaklah membayar kepada Bank fi yang
dinyatakan dalam Jadual Kedua.

Permohonan bagi pembaharuan lesen

6. Seseorang pemegang lesen dalam memohon suatu pembaharuan lesen
hendaklah mengemukakan kepada Bank maklumat yang berikut:

(a) akaun tahunan terkini yang diaudit atau jika tiada akaun tersebut,
akaun pengurusan;

(b) perancangan perniagaan yang kukuh dan unjuran aliran tunai bagi
tiga tahun ke hadapan; dan

(c) suatu perakuan oleh lembaga pengarahnya bahawa pemegang
lesen itu telah mematuhi Akta ini dan Akta Pencegahan
Penggubahan Wang Haram dan Pencegahan Pembiayaan
Keganasan 2001, peraturan -peraturannya, garis panduannya,
pekelilingnya, piawaiannya dan notisnya yang dikeluarkan di
bawah kedua -dua Akta itu dan tidak pernah terlibat dalam atau
memberi kemudahan kepada mana-mana aktiviti haram.

MONEY SERVICES BUSINESS ACT 2011

MONEY SERVICES BUSINESS (LICENSING) REGULATIONS 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 78(1), subsection 4(3), paragraph
5(1)(b), subsections 7(3) and 8(1) and paragraph 9(1) (b) of the Money Services
Business Act 2011 [ Act 731 ], the Bank, with the approval of the Minister, makes the
following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Money Services Business
(Licensing) Regulations 2012.

(2) These Regulations are deemed to have come into operation on
1 December 2011.

Classes of licence
2. The classes and descriptions of licence in respect of money services business are
set out in the First Schedule.

Submission of information for application of licence
3. An applicant in applying for a licence  under subsection 5(1) of the Act shall
submit to the Bank the following information:

(a) particulars of the shareholders of the applicant—

(i) if the shareholder of the applicant is a company, the name,
address and contact details of its shareholders, the amou nt
and percentage of shares held in the applicant; or

(ii) if the shareholder of the applicant is other than a company,
the name, address and details on how to contact that
person, the amount and percentage of shares held in the
applicant;

(b) names, address and details on how to contact the directors and
senior management of the applicant, their roles and
responsibilities in the proposed money services business;

(c) the proposed corporate structure of the applicant, its relationship
with any related company and holding company within the group,
the names of such companies, percentage of shareholding and a
brief description of the activities of each of those companies;

(d) the proposed business plan of the money services business—

(i) feasibility analysis covering i ts business model, potential
customer base, distribution channels and projected growth
prospect for the next three years;

(ii) income and cash flow projection for the next three years;
and

(iii) the sources of the applicant's funds to fulfill the minimum
capital fu nd and to fund the operations of its money
services business;

(e) the proposed governance arrangements, internal controls, and risk
management framework to manage the operations of the proposed
money services business to ensure—

(i) proper conduct of money services business and integrity of
its operations;

(ii) compliance with the requirements of this Act and its
regulations, guidelines, circulars, standards or notices;

(iii) address the likelihood of mismanagement and fraud; and

(iv) adequate customer protection; and

(f) the proposed internal control mechanisms and compliance
programs to comply with the requirements of the Anti -Money
Laundering and Anti -Terrorism Financing Act 2001 [ Act 613] and
its guidelines relating to—

(i) the proposed line of authority and responsibilities of the
board of directors and its management in implementing
anti-money laundering and counter financing of terrorism
measures; and

(ii) the proposed anti -money laundering and counter financing
of terrorism compliance program relating to the proposed
policies and procedures for customer acceptance, customer
due-diligence, ongoing monitoring, record keeping,
reporting of suspicious transactions and combating the
financing of terrorism.

Period of licence
4. A licence shall be in force for a  period of three years unless a shorter period is
otherwise specified by the Bank in the licence.

Fees
5. A licensee shall pay to the Bank the fees as set out in the Second Schedule.

Application for renewal of licence
6. A licensee in applying for a rene wal of a licence shall submit to the Bank the
following information:

(a) the latest audited annual accounts or in the absence of such
accounts, the management accounts;

(b) a sound business plan and cash flow projection for the next three
financial years; and

(c) a declaration by its board of directors that the licensee has
complied with all the requirements of this Act and the Anti -Money
Laundering and Anti -Terrorism Financing Act 2001, the
regulations, guidelines, circulars, standards and notices issu ed
under both Acts and has not been involved in or facilitated any
illegal activity.
